news_items.title: US Non-Farm Payrolls surge +265K vs +175K expected; Unemployment Rate steady at 3.9%
news_items.summary: Average hourly earnings up +0.4% MoM (+4.1% YoY). Market recalibrates Fed policy pricing to factor in 4.25% terminal rate by Q1 2027. US 10-Year yield surges 12 bps to 4.58%.

news_items.title: Fed Chair Powell states strong labor data validates restrictive policy stance
news_items.summary: Powell noted inflation progress has stalled around 3.3% Core PCE and committee is prepared to hike again if wage growth remains hot.
